snippet.title: MIRAI #167 | Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Official Demo Launch Trailer for MIRAI #167!

A fast-paced 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewind time and jump through portals to escape a world overrun by AI.

Upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

MIRAI #167 is coming to PC in 2026. Wishlist and play the free demo NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861660/MIRAI_167_Demo/
